review_scope: independent English translation semantic equivalence and preservation of prior accepted technical conclusions; no experiments rerun
identity_boundary: This is an actual independent subagent translation/acceptance-equivalence review, not a second GitHub account approval and not fresh execution of historical experiments.
authorship_boundary: No translation authored by /root/translate_contracts is included as an independently reviewed translation here. Its 12 Design translations are reviewed by other agents. All 30 changed Design research files listed here were personally read. The six general research seed documents are outside this report and retain separate actual review by /root/translate_plan.
methodology: Derived source/target pairs from git-show accepted baselines and actual integrated files, rather than treating author replacement maps as evidence.

Read all 276 unique changed line pairs for the 45 assigned task packets, preserving a full occurrence map for repeated template text. Every final packet was reconstructed from the baseline plus the reviewed pairs and the separately reread final common-mandate correction, then compared byte for byte.

Read all 273 unique changed source/target pairs for the 25 remaining research files; these represent 454 actual changed line/JSON-value occurrences. Complete JSON shapes, nonlanguage scalars, line counts, numeric occurrences, link destinations, inline code, and executable examples were separately checked.

Personally read all 550 lines of the full R07 report/probe and R08/R09/R11 source/target documents, reading unchanged English once after equality comparison. Previously resolved peer findings in R11 were read in their final corrected source context.

Read every distinct Research-graph semantic change and every changed fragment title; compare every other JSON key, scalar, list length/order, dependency, requirement, and technical field with the accepted baseline.

Read all changed Plan current-policy, README, template, index, and renderer text; verify exact inventory coverage and nontext Python AST equality. The completion validator adaptation changes only the task-revision text marker.

Verified all 80 unchanged assigned output files byte for byte against accepted source commits, including the D32 ledger. Prior accepted technical conclusions, raw evidence identities, historical failure records, and future product obligations are retained; no unrelated experiment was rerun.
Re-read all six author fixes for the findings below and checked their final integrated bytes. Inspected the narrow final mandate, packet-hash, and graph-binding changes before recording these pins.
Used semantic_projection_v1 only for the cyclic Research graph; all actual packet/output/current-document review inputs remain full exact SHA-256 bindings.
